about_the_game:
Prophecy of Ashen is a medieval fantasy role-playing game (CRPG) set against a backdrop of magic, deep social conflicts, religious beliefs, and power struggles. Players will enter a world consumed by flames and ash, exploring the kingdom’s borders, the mysterious Ashen-descendant tribes, the corrupt church, and an impending disaster that threatens to engulf the entire continent.

In Prophecy of Ashen, you will play as a key messenger, navigating the kingdom’s political whirlpool and religious conflicts. By interacting with different factions and uncovering the secrets behind the Sacred Flame, you will face unavoidable choices: remain loyal to the kingdom and church’s orders, or side with the fanatical Ashen-descendants and challenge the societal status quo?

Key Features:

  • Rich Roleplaying and Choices: In a world filled with hostility and division, your decisions will shape the fate of the kingdom. Every choice you make will impact both your personal story and the larger world around you.

  • Unique Religious and Political Setting: Explore a kingdom deeply influenced by the faith of the Three Sacred Flames, experiencing conflicts born from racial and religious differences. By learning about the Ashen-descendant tribes and the Sacred Law Tribunal, players will be confronted with moral and spiritual challenges.

  • Tactical Turn-based Combat System: Engage in intense battles and strategic confrontations, using magic, weapons, and terrain advantages to defeat your enemies. Whether it’s quelling Ashen-descendant uprisings, defending against monster invasions, or resisting foreign expansions, you’ll need to make strategic decisions based on the changing tides of war.

  • Diverse Character Development: Shape your character's skills, magic, and gear based on your choices. You can choose to work with the church, becoming a warrior imbued with divine powers, or delve into independent magic to uncover the secrets of the Ashen-descendants, becoming a mysterious sorcerer.

  • Immersive World and Storytelling: Every piece of land in the game has its own unique story, and all events and characters are tightly connected to the kingdom’s past and future. Explore ancient ruins, mysterious villages, and cities ravaged by war and strife.

Game Background:

In the kingdom of Latalan, the fate of the Ashen-descendants is intertwined with that of the entire realm. Once tainted by the molten magma of the Demon Lord’s infernal volcano, seeking power at all costs, their descendants now bear the unclean flame, relegated to the fringes of society. However, during the war with the Frost Giants, the Ashen-descendants’ valorous efforts earned them the church’s forgiveness—The Ashen Pardon allowed them to reenter society. Yet even with this, they have been driven to madness by continued discrimination and rejection.

Now, the Ashen-descendant Knights' violent uprising has shaken the kingdom and provoked the wrath of the gods. Tensions between the church and the Ashen-descendants are growing, and society is on the brink of collapse. As a brave messenger, your mission is to travel through this land consumed by fire and ash and deliver the warning of divine wrath.

short_description: "Prophecy of Ashen" is a medieval fantasy role-playing game. The game revolves around the conflict between the Ashen descendants and the Hall of Divine Edict, and players must make difficult choices throughout the game to determine their fate.
